meta.name: ai-product-photography
meta.description: Generate professional AI product photography and commercial images. Models: FLUX, Imagen 3, Grok, Seedream for product shots, lifestyle images, mockups. Capabilities: studio lighting, lifestyle scenes, packaging, e-commerce photos. Use for: e-commerce, Amazon listings, Shopify, marketing, advertising, mockups. Triggers: product photography, product shot, commercial photography, e-commerce images, amazon product photo, shopify images, product mockup, studio product shot, lifestyle product image, advertising photo, packshot, product render, product image ai

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成专业级电商产品图和商业广告图
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速生成高质量电商产品图和营销视觉素材
copy.tagline_en: Generate professional e-commerce product photos and commercial images
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly create high-quality product photos and marketing visuals for e-commerce

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能通过命令行生成专业产品摄影图，支持多种模型和风格，如白底图、生活场景、英雄特写等。
howto.when: 当用户要求生成产品摄影图、电商图片或产品展示图时触发，例如提到“产品摄影”、“亚马逊图片”等关键词。

say.text: 帮我生成一张白色背景的耳机产品图。
say.note: Claude 会调用 FLUX 模型生成白底产品图。

say.text: 制作一张咖啡杯在木桌上的生活场景图。
say.note: Claude 会生成生活风格的产品照片。

say.text: 生成一张钻石戒指的珠宝摄影图。
say.note: Claude 会生成珠宝类产品摄影图。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can generate professional product photography via command line, supporting multiple models and styles such as white background, lifestyle scenes, hero shots, etc.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to generate product photography, e-commerce images, or product mockups, e.g., mentioning "product photography", "Amazon image", etc.

say_en.text: Generate a white background product photo of headphones.
say_en.note: Claude will use FLUX model to create a white background product image.

say_en.text: Create a lifestyle scene of a coffee mug on a wooden table.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a lifestyle product photo.

say_en.text: Generate a jewelry product photo of a diamond ring.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a jewelry product photography image.
